info.description:
The API the RosterChief native apps are built on. Read the developer guide first:
**[/api/docs/](/api/docs/)**.

* **Sign-in** is a separate API (allauth headless): `/api/auth/app/v1/`, spec at
  [/api/auth/openapi.html](/api/auth/openapi.html). It returns the `access_token` used here.
* **Authentication:** `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` on every call except `/meta`.
* **Two planes:** account endpoints (`/me`, `/clubs`, `/devices`, `/meta`) on the base domain;
  club endpoints (`/context`, …) on the club's own host — take it from `api_base_url` in `/clubs`.
* **Who:** club endpoints act for the account's managed people (`/context`). Reads take
  `member_id` (one person) or `all`; writes always name one `member_id`.
* **Errors** always use `{"error": {"code", "message", "fields"}}`; branch on `code`.
info.title: RosterChief app API

get.description: Reports this account filed in this club, newest first, with the team's replies.

post.description: Filed as the account's own person (never on behalf of a child).

get.description:
Invitations, referee/official sign-ups (open, accepted or declined) and events a person is
kept off by an open club requirement (`blocked`), soonest first. A declined referee/official
sign-up (`status` `declined`) stays until the game starts, in case they change their mind. Cancelled events
are left out, and so are referee/official sign-ups for games that are already over (only
your own and your family's games as a player show when looking back). Fetch the next window by passing the previous `to` as `from`.

parameters.description: End of the window, exclusive (default and maximum: `from` + 92 days).
parameters.name: to

schema.description: End of the window, exclusive (default and maximum: `from` + 92 days).
schema.title: To

parameters.description: `game` or `training`; anything else means all kinds.
parameters.name: kind

schema.description: `game` or `training`; anything else means all kinds.
schema.title: Kind

parameters.description: A managed person's id (see `/context`), or `all` (the default) for everyone the account acts for.
parameters.name: member_id

schema.description: A managed person's id (see `/context`), or `all` (the default) for everyone the account acts for.
schema.title: Member Id

post.description:
Returns the subscription URL, the only time it's ever shown (only a hash is
stored). Calling it again replaces the link: the old URL stops working at once,
which is also how a leaked link is revoked. One link covers every club.
post.summary: Create or replace the calendar link

get.description:
Every active club the account has a real tie to, with the base URL to use for that
club's endpoints. Cache it; offer a club picker when there is more than one.

Call when a club is opened (and after pull-to-refresh): the season, the people the
account acts for (`member_id` values for other endpoints), coached teams, permissions
and features. `403 not_a_member` means the account has no tie to this club.

post.description:
Call after sign-in and whenever the push token changes (iOS may rotate it). Keyed by
`installation_id`: repeating the call updates the same registration. If another account
registered this install before, it moves to the signed-in account.

delete.description: Call on sign-out, before discarding the tokens. Only the account's own installs.

get.description:
The event as the account's family sees it: their answers, a published line-up,
sign-ups (a declined one stays until the game starts, as in the calendar), tasks and the
squad's response counts.

delete.description:
Stop following this game directly. Safe to repeat. If a team playing in it is followed, the
game is still followed through that team (`via_team` in the answer): unfollow the team with
`PUT /game-follows` for that.

put.description:
Follow this game for live updates: the same pushes a followed team gives (goals, penalties,
the result), and a card on Home while it is on. Safe to repeat. `422 not_a_game` for anything
but a game, `404 feature_disabled` without game timelines.

post.description:
Call when a Live Activity for this game starts, and again whenever its push token changes.
One activity per install and game: repeating the call replaces the token. `404 not_found` when
`installation_id` isn't one of the account's registered installs, `422 not_a_game` for anything
but a game, `404 feature_disabled` without game timelines.
post.summary: Register a Live Activity's push token

delete.description: Call when the activity ends or the user dismisses it. Safe to repeat.
delete.summary: Remove a Live Activity's push token

post.description: As for referees; needs the club's `officials` feature (`404 feature_disabled`).
post.summary: Accept or decline being an official

post.description:
For a managed person's referee invite. `409 signup_unavailable` when it can't be
accepted (e.g. every referee slot is taken); the invite stays open.

Answer for one managed person. Safe to repeat: it sets the answer, and returns
the stored state. Refusals: `409 event_started`, `409 rsvp_closed` (deadline
passed), `409 not_in_lineup` (`dropout` without being selected), `422
note_required` (`absent`/`dropout` without a reason). `404` when the person isn't
invited.

delete.description: Safe to repeat: without a claim it just returns the task.

post.description:
Claimed as the account's own person. `409 task_unavailable` when it's full or
already claimed by this account.

get.description:
Every form any managed person is (or was) asked to fill in, one row per person,
newest first; `submitted_at` is null while still to do.

Read-only, for a managed person's own response. Every field of the form is listed;
`value` is null where it was left blank.

The fields to render. Always readable while addressed to the family, even when
closed (`is_open` false): submitting then answers `409 form_unavailable`.

post.description:
Submit for one of the form's `addressed` people. Send an `Idempotency-Key`: a
repeated request returns the first response instead of a second submission.
`422` carries `fields` per field `key`; `409 form_unavailable` means closed, not yet
open, or the maximum number of responses was reached.

answers.description: Field `key` → value: string, number, `YYYY-MM-DD`, bool, or a list of option values for `multichoice`.

member_id.description: Who the response is for (one of the form's `addressed` people).

schema.description: Only needed for forms with `file` fields: one part per field `key` (repeat a key for `multichoice`, `true`/`on` for a checkbox), files as file parts.

get.description:
The club's teams, and which of them this account gets live game pushes
for (goals, penalties, the result -- opt-in). `404 feature_disabled` when
the club doesn't have game timelines.
get.summary: Teams followed for live game updates

put.description:
Replaces the set of followed teams (an empty list stops all live game
pushes for this club). Safe to repeat.
put.summary: Choose teams to follow for live game updates

get.description:
Everything the Home screen shows, capped the way the web app caps it: `member_cards`
(per person, their next unanswered invitation and their next event they are going to),
other open asks, free task slots, open dues, the latest news and forms still to fill
in. `rsvp_needed` and `next_going` are the older single-card form of `member_cards`.

parameters.description: A managed person's id (see `/context`), or `all` (the default) for everyone the account acts for.
parameters.name: member_id

schema.description: A managed person's id (see `/context`), or `all` (the default) for everyone the account acts for.
schema.title: Member Id

patch.description:
Account-wide, for every club. `email_notifications`: `always` (default) or `unless_app`
-- skip the notification email while this account has the app installed.

get.description: Only the account's own person and their children (`404` for anyone else).

patch.description:
Send only the fields that change. `422` lists invalid fields (e.g. a phone
number that can't be parsed).

get.description:
The same rule as the website: the member, their parents/guardians, staff who may
see them, or anyone when the photo is public. Anyone else gets `404`.

post.description:
Replaces the managed person's photo. Returns the profile with the new `photo_url`.
The photo stays private (family and club staff) unless `photo_public_consent` is on.

photo.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP (HEIC: convert to JPEG first), at most 10 MB.

photo_public_consent.description: Optional: also set whether it may appear on the club's public website.

get.description:
No authentication. Call on launch: if the app's version is below
`min_supported_app_version`, show an 'update required' screen.

Published news for members, newest first. Titles and excerpts follow
`Accept-Language` (English when asked for and written, the club's language otherwise).

delete.description: Deletes every notification of every managed person (not just marks them read).

get.description:
Newest first. A parent sees their children's notifications too; `member_id` says
whose each one is. `source` points at what to open.

parameters.description: A managed person's id, or `all` (the default).
parameters.name: member_id

schema.description: A managed person's id, or `all` (the default).
schema.title: Member Id

get.description: Across every managed person: use it for the app icon badge.

post.description: Safe to repeat; returns the notification with its `read_at`.

get.description:
Open balances of every managed person. People covered by one registration share one
item (one invoice, one early-payment offer).
Only for a registration covering a managed person, once the club has confirmed it.

post.description:
The same entries as the quote. The club reviews it, then sends the invoice; the
account gets a confirmation email now. Send an `Idempotency-Key`: a double tap
must not register twice.

get.description:
Seasons open for registration and, once one is chosen (automatic when there's only
one), its products, teams and free jersey numbers.

post.description:
Validates and prices the entries without saving anything. `422` names the entry
and field, e.g. `entries.1.variant_id`.

get.description:
Re-priced to what checkout would charge now. Pass `code` to preview a discount
code (`discount` or `discount_error`); only checkout actually redeems it. Wrong codes
count towards a throttle.

post.description:
Adds to an existing line for the same product, option, person and
personalisation. Returns the whole cart. Send an `Idempotency-Key` so a retried tap
doesn't add twice.

get.description: Newest first, also while the shop is closed.

post.description:
Turns the cart into an order, paid at the club on pickup. Send an
`Idempotency-Key`: a double tap must not order twice. `409 checkout_failed` carries
the reason (empty cart, unavailable lines, a code that can't be used) in `message`.

get.description:
Events the team is invited to, soonest first, cancelled ones included (`cancelled: true`).
Any staff of the team.

parameters.description: Earliest start (default: now). Pass a past time to look back.
parameters.name: from

schema.description: Earliest start (default: now). Pass a past time to look back.
schema.title: From

post.description:
The team is the audience (plus `invited_member_ids`, minus `excluded_member_ids`). Players
start as `no_response`. With `notify` (the default) everybody invited is told. Send an
`Idempotency-Key`. Managers only.
post.summary: Create an event for the team

delete.description:
A series occurrence is cancelled (the series will not regenerate it); a one-off event is
deleted with its attendance. Managers only.

parameters.description: For an occurrence of a series: keep it, marked `cancelled`, instead of removing it. A one-off event is always removed.
parameters.name: keep_record

schema.description: For an occurrence of a series: keep it, marked `cancelled`, instead of removing it. A one-off event is always removed.
schema.title: Keep Record

parameters.description: Tell everybody invited that it is cancelled. A removed event leaves a notification that opens the calendar.
parameters.name: notify

schema.description: Tell everybody invited that it is cancelled. A removed event leaves a notification that opens the calendar.
schema.title: Notify

get.summary: One event, with what editing needs

patch.description:
Only the fields sent change. For an occurrence of a series, `scope` says what happens to the
rest of the series (see the field). Managers only.

get.description:
One row per invited person. `filter`: `responded` (the default: in or maybe),
`silent`, `declined`, or `all`. `counts` always cover everybody. Any staff of the team.
get.summary: Who is coming to an event

post.description:
Sets `showed_up` for the listed rows, leaving the rest alone, and returns the sheet as
`GET …/attendance` would (same `filter`). Repeating a call changes nothing. An id that is
not a row of this event fails the whole call with `422 unknown_attendance`. Managers only.
Later series-wide changes skip it. Managers only.
post.summary: Stop an occurrence following its series

post.description:
Sends the in-app (and, if they have the app, push) reminder to everyone still on
`no_response`. Accepts an `Idempotency-Key`: a retry does not remind twice. Managers only.
post.summary: Nudge players who have not answered

get.description:
For a picker: every location of the club by name, optionally narrowed by `q` (name or city).
`{items: [...]}`, no pagination.

post.description: Managers only. Send an `Idempotency-Key`: a repeated tap otherwise makes a second one.

get.description: For a picker, by name; `q` narrows by name. `{items: [...]}`, no pagination.

post.description: Managers only. Send an `Idempotency-Key`.

Generates the occurrences for the next 90 days now (nobody is notified per occurrence; the
daily reminders pick them up) and extends nightly. Send an `Idempotency-Key`. Managers only.

delete.description:
Removes every occurrence, past ones with their attendance too. To keep history, stop it
instead: `PATCH` its `until`. Managers only.
delete.summary: Delete a series and all its occurrences

patch.description:
Only the fields sent change. The template (title, kind, place, opponent, durations, invited
and excluded people) reaches every upcoming occurrence that still follows the series. A new
`dtstart` or pattern only decides *future* dates: existing occurrences keep theirs, and ones that
no longer fit stay until deleted. Managers only.

get.description:
Squad size, the session to show (today's, else the next one) with in / out / silent
counts and its reply deadline, and what needs the coach: silent players for that session
and every upcoming game or tournament without a published line-up. Any staff of the team.
